name: 恒星之火
description: 对4格内1个敌方棋子造成等同于本棋子攻击力200%的法术伤害，并对其周围3×3范围内其他敌方棋子造成等量法术伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 4, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var targetX = target.x; var targetY = target.y; var targetId = target.instanceId; var damage = Math.floor(caster.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); var result = dealDamage(caster, target, damage, 'magical', battle, context.skill.id); var others = battle.pieces.filter(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId !== targetId && piece.ownerPlayerId !== caster.ownerPlayerId && piece.currentHp > 0 && Math.abs(piece.x - targetX) <= 1 && Math.abs(piece.y - targetY) <= 1; }); if (others.length) dealDamage(caster, others, damage, 'magical', battle, context.skill.id); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '的恒星之火对' + target.name + '造成' + (result.damage || damage) + '点法术伤害，并波及周围' + others.length + '名敌人' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { var damage = Math.floor(piece.attack * skillDef.powerMultiplier); return { description: "对4格内1个敌方棋子及其周围3×3范围内其他敌方棋子造成" + damage + '点法术伤害。', expectedValues: { damage: damage } }; }
